#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Re-evaluate d051 LLaMA 70B Few-NERD results with type+text matching.

Compares:
  - text-only recall (original buggy method): match on text.lower() only
  - type+text recall (corrected): match on (type.lower(), text.lower()) pairs
"""
import json
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

BASE_DIR = Path("/root/schema-dag-extraction")
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR / "src"))

from few_nerd_utils import load_few_nerd


def evaluate_dir(output_dir, samples):
    summary_text_only = {}
    summary_type_text = {}

    for rp in sorted(output_dir.glob("results_count_*.jsonl")):
        count_key = rp.stem.replace("results_", "")
        batch_recalls_text = defaultdict(list)
        batch_recalls_typed = defaultdict(list)

        with open(rp) as f:
            for line in f:
                if not line.strip():
                    continue
                r = json.loads(line)
                sid = r["sample_id"]
                bid = r["batch_id"]
                preds = r["predictions"]
                batch_types_set = set(r["batch_types"])

                gold_entities = samples[sid].get("entities", [])

                # Gold: filter to batch types
                gold_texts = set(
                    e["text"].lower()
                    for e in gold_entities
                    if e["type"] in batch_types_set
                )
                gold_pairs = set(
                    (e["type"].lower(), e["text"].lower())
                    for e in gold_entities
                    if e["type"] in batch_types_set
                )

                # Pred: text-only (old buggy)
                pred_texts = set(
                    p["text"].lower()
                    for p in preds
                    if isinstance(p, dict) and "text" in p
                )
                # Pred: type+text (corrected)
                pred_pairs = set(
                    (p["type"].lower(), p["text"].lower())
                    for p in preds
                    if isinstance(p, dict) and "text" in p and "type" in p
                )

                # Text-only recall
                if gold_texts:
                    recall_text = len(gold_texts & pred_texts) / len(gold_texts)
                else:
                    recall_text = 1.0
                batch_recalls_text[bid].append(recall_text)

                # Type+text recall
                if gold_pairs:
                    recall_typed = len(gold_pairs & pred_pairs) / len(gold_pairs)
                else:
                    recall_typed = 1.0
                batch_recalls_typed[bid].append(recall_typed)

        text_means = [np.mean(v) for v in batch_recalls_text.values()]
        typed_means = [np.mean(v) for v in batch_recalls_typed.values()]

        summary_text_only[count_key] = {
            "mean_recall": float(np.mean(text_means)),
            "std_recall": float(np.std(text_means)),
            "n_batches": len(text_means),
        }
        summary_type_text[count_key] = {
            "mean_recall": float(np.mean(typed_means)),
            "std_recall": float(np.std(typed_means)),
            "n_batches": len(typed_means),
        }

    return summary_text_only, summary_type_text


def main():
    print("Loading Few-NERD test samples (n=1000)...")
    samples = load_few_nerd(split="test", max_samples=1000)
    print(f"Loaded {len(samples)} samples")

    llama_dir = BASE_DIR / "artifacts/d051_llama-3.1-70b-fp8_fewnerd_n25_s42"

    print(f"\n=== LLaMA 70B Few-NERD ===")
    print(f"Dir: {llama_dir}")
    text_only, type_text = evaluate_dir(llama_dir, samples)

    # Save type+text summary
    out_path = llama_dir / "summary_type_text.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(type_text, f, indent=2)
    print(f"Saved: {out_path}")

    # Print comparison table
    print(f"\n{'count_key':<12} {'text_only_recall':>18} {'type+text_recall':>18} {'delta':>10}")
    print("-" * 62)
    for ck in sorted(text_only.keys(), key=lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])):
        to_r = text_only[ck]["mean_recall"]
        tt_r = type_text[ck]["mean_recall"]
        delta = tt_r - to_r
        print(f"{ck:<12} {to_r:>18.4f} {tt_r:>18.4f} {delta:>10.4f}")

    # Verify: type+text <= text-only
    print("\n=== Sanity check ===")
    all_ok = True
    for ck in type_text:
        if type_text[ck]["mean_recall"] > text_only[ck]["mean_recall"] + 1e-9:
            print(f"WARNING: {ck} type+text ({type_text[ck]['mean_recall']:.4f}) > text_only ({text_only[ck]['mean_recall']:.4f})")
            all_ok = False
    if all_ok:
        print("OK: type+text recall <= text-only recall for all counts")

    # Print full summary JSON
    print("\n=== summary_type_text.json ===")
    print(json.dumps(type_text, indent=2))

    print("\n=== summary_text_only.json (for comparison) ===")
    print(json.dumps(text_only, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
